purpose: Cross-discipline keyword map for free-venue signal mining. Each family is an ESTATE LAW (something this repo already enforces or owes), its triggers in the wild, and the same law as it appears in other disciplines. A hit is only useful if it routes to a binding - the tool or ticket that would consume it.
notes: Triggers are mined against free venues only (HN Algolia, Lobsters RSS, Reddit RSS, arXiv Atom). X has no anonymous API and is deliberately absent.
anti lists exist because keyword mining without negatives is a noise pump (see family 'repeat-gate').
estate_binding names the artifact that would consume a hit. If a family has no binding, do not mine it - it is curiosity, not signal.
